job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Kern County Employees' Retirement Association (KCERA) RFP for audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year agreement (audits of fiscal year ending June 30, 2023 and the two subsequent fiscal years), subject to annual Board review; the original term may be extended for up to an additional three years by mutual agreement of KCERA and the firm.
job.acceptance: Accept 3+up to3 years, mutual extension. Audit fiscal years and annual-review/negotiation detail need not all be volunteered.

reviews.reason: This is a Clark County, Washington RFP for deferred compensation plan administration, not KCERA’s RFP for audit services. Its three-year term and seven-year extension option concern a different contract and do not support the requested facts.
quotes: Request for Proposal #955 Deferred Compensation 457 Plan Administrator

Clark County is soliciting proposals from qualified firms to provide retirement plan administration, record keeping, education, communications, investment-related, and other services for the 457 Deferred Compensation Plan effective January 1, 2027.
Clark County reserves the right to extend the contract resulting from this RFP for a period of seven (7) additional years, in one (1) year increments
